verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence of official SDKs is a claim that Adyen supports online payments for web, iOS, Android, React Native and Flutter, which implies official client-side libraries but never names or documents them. The OpenAPI specs can be used to generate client libraries, but that is a developer building block and earns no credit. The MCP server is a separate capability. Missing for 10: explicitly named official server-side SDKs (language list, packages, repos), documentation of the client SDKs themselves, versioning/maintenance details, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
